title: Farbigkeit / Schwelle
slide_intent: Assign color alternatives by role so an accent stays recognizable across backgrounds.
strategic_value: Prioritizing DB Red can keep the Schwelle associated with the core identity while Lilac adds expression.
demonstration: Primary red/white combinations appear above expressive lilac combinations on light and dark backgrounds.
practical_value: Prefer DB Red; select White or Lilac within the defined options when context and contrast warrant them.

content_islands.name: Primary use
content_islands.spec: Pair red on White with red or white on Cold Black.

content_islands.name: Expressive use
content_islands.spec: Pair lilac on White with lilac on Cold Black below.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy connects color selection with visibility and a coherent brand appearance.
reference_purposes.Application: Four panels demonstrate five primary and expressive color/background combinations, including both red and white on Cold Black.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The stated colors are DB Red, White and Lilac, with DB Red taking priority over Lilac.
